adopt.title: Adopt Noticom node
adopt.description: Adopt node **{node_id}**? After you press Submit, the node chirps. Press its button within 60 seconds to confirm.

error.button_timeout: The node's button wasn't pressed within 60 seconds. Try again.
error.no_internal_url: Home Assistant has no local URL configured (Settings → System → Network).

abort.discovery_only: Noticom nodes are added automatically when they're discovered on your network. Install the node software on a Raspberry Pi to get started. (Adding a node by IP address is planned.)
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered node didn't report a node ID.

init.title: Button
init.description: How this node's intercom button is wired. The node restarts to apply a change.

data_description.button_pin: BCM GPIO number. 13 is on the HAT's Grove connector; 17 is the HAT's onboard button.
data_description.button_nc: Turn on if the pin reads high when the button is pressed (normally closed). Most buttons are normally open.
